title: The 20-Hour Istanbul Layover: Two Continents Before Boarding
description: My connection gave me 20 hours in Istanbul, and I refuse to call that a layover — that's a trip. Ferry across the Bosphorus at sunrise for the price of a coffee, a simit on each continent, the Basilica Cistern before the queue forms, and a barber shave I didn't plan but don't regret. What's actually doable from the airport with a carry-on and no hotel.

comments.comment: The ferry-as-cruise trick is the best free tour in Europe. Did you do the full Kadıköy loop or just cross and come back?
Full loop — the return leg at golden hour is the whole point. Even ate on the Asian side to say I did.
